name: Central Highlands of Sri Lanka
description: Rising to about 2,500 metres in south-central Sri Lanka, these misty highlands bring together three protected areas: Peak Wilderness, Horton Plains National Park and the Knuckles Conservation Forest. Cloud forest and rain forest cover the slopes, sheltering endangered wildlife such as the Sri Lankan leopard, purple-faced langurs and the rare Horton Plains slender loris. It is one of the world's richest biodiversity hotspots.
